'''Warrl''' was a leafy [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native only to the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]], a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] system within the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The [[Myyydril]] tribe used it in their cooking, particularly in a drink known as [[Warrl Surprise]]. The plant was edible to many different [[Species/Legends|species]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], in an effort to gain the Myyydril tribe's trust, collected ten warrl leaves for a [[Gender/Legends|female]] tribesman named [[Kirrir]], who worked at the small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] within their village. Kirrir rewarded the spacer with a bottle of Warrl Surprise for the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient's]] trouble.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Warrl appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], released on [[May 5]], [[2005]], as a collectible quest object. As part of a large, overarching chain of quests, the player was tasked with collecting ten samples of warrl for a Myyydril tribesman. The player was rewarded with a bottle of Warrl Surprise, which was a single use food item that increased the consumer's agility for a short time. The plant and the Warrl Surprise made from it was edible by all playable species in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
